user.title: Add a QIDI Box
user.description: Choose the printer the QIDI Box is attached to. The printer must already be set up with the Moonraker integration; the Box's entities join that printer's device.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the printer's Moonraker. Is the printer on?
error.no_box: This printer does not report a QIDI Box.
error.printer_not_loaded: The Moonraker integration has not finished loading this printer yet. Try again when it is online.

abort.already_configured: This printer's Box is already set up.
abort.no_printers: No printer without a Box entry found. Set the printer up with the Moonraker integration first.

data_description.polling_rate: During a filament change, and for 30 s after a command, the Box is polled every 2 s.

load_filament.name: Load filament
load_filament.description: Load the filament of a Box slot into the toolhead (heats, cuts, unloads what is loaded, loads; about 2.5 minutes). Returns once the printer has accepted the command.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Slot number: 1-4 on Box 1 (1A-1D), 5-8 on Box 2 …

unload_filament.name: Unload filament
unload_filament.description: Unload the filament of a Box slot from the toolhead.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Slot number: 1-4 on Box 1 (1A-1D), 5-8 on Box 2 …

eject_filament.name: Eject filament
eject_filament.description: Push the filament of a Box slot back out of the Box.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Slot number: 1-4 on Box 1 (1A-1D), 5-8 on Box 2 …

set_slot_filament.name: Set slot filament
set_slot_filament.description: Tell the Box which filament is in a slot (as on the touchscreen).

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Slot number: 1-4 on Box 1 (1A-1D), 5-8 on Box 2 …

vendor.name: Vendor
vendor.description: Vendor name from the printer's filament list, e.g. QIDI or Generic.

filament.name: Filament
filament.description: Filament NAME from the printer's list, e.g. PLA Basic (not the id).

send_gcode.name: Send G-code
send_gcode.description: Run G-code on the printer, reporting Klipper's error if it fails.

gcode.name: G-code
gcode.description: One command, several lines, or a list.

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: Wait until the command finishes. Turn off for long commands: the action then returns after a few seconds unless Klipper rejected it, and later errors are logged.
